the current transients arise from charge transfer at the asperity level, which in this case is dominated by the detachment of individual asperities.

the transient current signal can be used as an indicator of the wear mechanism.
transient currents can be used to probe the dynamics and mechanics of wear processes.
transient current signals can be used to identify the onset of wear in sliding systems, even at low contact forces.
